concept.title: Metric couriers
concept.notation: X ≠ ∅; d: X × X → [0, ∞). The pair (X, d) is a metric space.
concept.hypotheses: The conditions below hold for every x, y, z ∈ X. X need not be a set of Euclidean points.
concept.visual_mapping: A finite representative example: X = {1,3,4}, d(a,b) = |a−b|, restricted from the usual metric on ℝ. Choose a start, a via point and a finish. Direct and detour lengths come from the engine.
concept.limitations: This finite example does not replace the general definition or prove the axioms on all real numbers. Vertical lanes, faces and cosmetic movement assert no additional mathematics.
concept.source_quote: No private course quotation is published. Original synthetic test: docs/examples/metric-spaces-test.tex.
